rationale.ai-review: LLMs judge the diff artifacts to predict their SEV risk
rationale.risk-routing: computed risk scores are thresholded to allocate diffs for gating
rationale.built-system: authors implemented working generative LLM prototypes for risk scoring
rationale.adopted: the baseline diff risk gating pipeline is used in production
rationale.general-code: evaluates regular developer diffs, not AI-generated code
rationale.risk-quality: evaluates a mitigation for it and reports an empirical result
